summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a transaction in own shares under its existing share buyback programme. On 21 May 2026, it purchased 5,456,645 ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International at a volume-weighted average price of 98.8215 pence per share (low 97.6600, high 99.8000 pence). These purchases, part of a programme announced on 30 January 2026, will be cancelled. The filing confirms an ongoing capital return to shareholders via open-market repurchases. It is a routine disclosure of share buyback execution without new corporate action, recommending watch for future buyback pace or completion updates.
